_comment: Copy to pyrightconfig.json and point venvPath/venv at your own environment.
The real file is gitignored because those two paths are machine-specific;
without them Pyright cannot resolve the installed packages.
reportTypedDictNotRequiredAccess is disabled deliberately: MigrationState is
total=False so LangGraph nodes can return partial updates, but new_state()
always fills every key, which makes state[...] reads safe.
tests/ relaxes reportArgumentType/reportCallIssue because fixtures pass
